name: AP_INCOME_TAX_REGIONS_
description: AP_INCOME_TAX_REGIONS contains information about the tax regions you use to record payment information for 1099 suppliers when your organization participates in the Combined Filing Program. AP_INCOME_TAX_REGIONS_ is the audit table for AP_INCOME_TAX_REGIONS.

columns.name: REGION_SHORT_NAME

columns.name: REGION_CODE
